name: Heap & DOM retention
description: Repeated post-GC heap, DOM-node and document measurements.
scope: Threshold signals under valid retained-state measurements; ownership and causes require investigation.

name: Listener lifecycle
description: Listener growth across repeated application use.
scope: Aggregate retained listeners; not proof that a specific view failed to unmount.

name: Runtime failures
description: Exceptions, console errors, HTTP/request failures and mutation-rate evidence.
scope: Recorded browser exercise only; delayed event attribution can be uncertain.

name: Constructor retention
description: Live instance counts for accessible configured constructors.
scope: Module-scoped constructors may be unavailable; missing measurements remain visible.

name: Journey outcomes
description: Explicit flow assertions, missing checks and per-cycle execution outcomes.
scope: User-authored expectations; unspecified business rules remain unverified.

name: Route navigation
description: Reachability, redirects, authentication walls and rendered-view verification.
scope: Navigation does not establish business correctness; fallback needs a visible-view assertion.

name: Async response order
description: Overlapping requests with controlled completion order and visible-state traces.
scope: Gateway fixtures; all exact-10000ms intervals disabled; 400ms stability bound.

name: Reconnect convergence
description: Real socket rejoin, authoritative snapshot, identity and visible multi-client agreement.
scope: Two local multiplayer clients, one rename, 2000ms bound; broken welcome is an injected control.

name: Navigation during pending work
description: Hold a real view request, leave the view, release the response and assert the active view stays unchanged.
scope: Purpose-built vulnerable/corrected app, 300ms post-response observation; generation guard tested, cancellation/subscriptions unverified.

name: HTTP failure & retry
description: Real local HTTP 503, partial-body disconnect and malformed JSON, followed by a visible retry and usable-state assertion.
scope: Purpose-built app, 600ms UI deadline; raw runtime faults stay visible even when recovery passes. Robot-main additionally checks real missing-provider rejection, editable form and retry availability, not successful generation or an in-place retry. Broken fixture button explicitly reset between cycles.

name: Concurrent write integrity
description: Rapid duplicate submits and acknowledged retries checked against a real server order/attempt ledger.
scope: One isolated in-memory process and two authored modes; no durable database, distributed conflicts or lost-response recovery claim.

name: Sustained responsiveness
description: Action latency and long tasks under repeated and heavy workloads.
scope: Needs calibrated hosts/workloads; measure separately from forced-GC capture.

name: Storage resilience
description: Cold editor startup with corrupt JSON or wrong schema, scoped storage exceptions, honest unsaved state and explicit retry verified by a fresh document.
scope: Real localStorage bytes; denied/quota exceptions are injected per key, not actual quota exhaustion. Iframe cold starts preserve the main document; 100ms post-cleanup idle.

name: Session expiry & recovery
description: Expired sessions during reads/writes, refresh and safe retry.
scope: Needs an isolated authenticating backend and invariants preventing duplicate side effects or unauthorized state.

name: Multi-client write conflicts
description: Two isolated clients save stale document versions in both acknowledged orders; explicit conflict reconciliation must preserve their distinct field edits.
scope: One in-memory backend, version checks and explicit dirty-field merge. Secondary-client errors retained by adapter; no distributed database or same-field automatic merge claim.
